generalComment.value: SC Tracks 25 mm with aluminium profile and Trevira CS textile is a site-fabricated acoustical wall system, which stretches textile over semi-rigid acoustic padding to control sound and add to the aesthetic design of interior spaces. The product is available in customized sizes and different textile options under the trade name Soft Cells Tracks 25mm. This EPD includes only the Soft Cells Tracks with aluminium frame and Trevira CS textile option. The product is declared as a construction product 'kit', since it consists of multiple separate components and placed on the market by a single manufacturer. The system consists of a single-sided layer of tensioned textile, attached to an aluminium frame profile, over a mineral-based acoustic core, with an integrated tension system.

SC Tracks 25 mm ist ein vor ort gefertigtes akustikwandsystem, das textil über eine halbstarre akustikpolsterung spannt, um den schall zu kontrollieren und zur ästhetischen gestaltung von innenräumen beizutragen. Das produkt wird als bauprodukt „bausatz“ deklariert, da es aus mehreren separaten komponenten besteht und von einem einzigen hersteller in verkehr gebracht wird.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The SC Tracks 25mm system consists of an aluminium frame, aluminium corners, a tensioning mechanism (steel leaf spring), a cone steel spring for retaining the absorber, a layer of mineral glass wool absorber, and Trevira CS textile (polyester textile) for the panel's wear. All components are manufactured by Kvadrat Acoustics suppliers, located in Europe. The components are delivered to Kvadrat Acoustics production site in Poland, where they are stored temporarily and processed before transported to warehouses in France, Germany, United Kingdom, and Spain. The Trevira CS textile is shipped from the supplier to the warehouses directly. Upon their arrival to the warehouses, the components are stored and assembled into a kit and then shipped to the building site. The components are not considered as a kit before they reach the warehouses exit gate. 
Technical data: 
The product has a sound adsorption class B to D according to ISO 11654 with a sound absorption coefficient of 0.55-0.85 (ISO 354). The fire performance is B-s2,d0 and C-s2,d0. The dimensions of the system after its installation in the building site are:

Typical size panel: 2600 mm x 1300 mm x 25 mm
Min. size panel: 1000 mm x 500 mm x 25 mm
Max. size panel: 6000 mm x 3000 mm x 25 mm

The components comprising the product kit are delivered at the building site with the following dimensions. The components arrive at the building site in fixed dimensions however, the number of component pieces differs across systems with different sizes.

Aluminium frame (2 profiles): 25.9 mm x 25 mm x 3000 mm
Aluminium corner: 35 mm x 35 mm x 25 mm
Tensioning mechanism (leaf spring): 7 mm x 14 mm x 1000 mm
Mineral glass wool absorber: 1200 mm x 1200 mm x 22 mm
Retaining cone spring: 6 mm x 6 mm x 2 mm
Trevira CS textile (roll): 400 mm x 400 mm x 1500 mm 
Declared unit: 
The declared unit is 1m2 configurable acoustic frame system. All SC Tracks 25mm sizes, included in this EPD, consist of the same type of components and no variation takes place regarding the components type. The amount of each component per declared unit differs between different product sizes. No component was included as an unweighted average. The results correspond to a typical SC Tracks 25 mm size of 1300 mm x 2600 mm x 25 mm (LxWxH), which represents all the product sizes included in this EPD. Finally, this EPD covers only the Trevira CS textile option, which is a polyester textile.

Das System SC Tracks 25mm besteht aus einem aluminiumrahmen, aluminiumecken, einem spannmechanismus (blattfeder), einer konusfeder zur aufnahme des absorbers, einer schicht mineralwolle-absorber und Trevira CS gewebe (polyestergewebe) für die abnutzung des paneels. Alle komponenten werden von lieferanten von Kvadrat Acoustics in Europa hergestellt. Die komponenten werden an den produktionsstandort von Kvadrat Acoustics in Polen geliefert, wo sie vorübergehend gelagert und verarbeitet werden, bevor sie zu lagern in Frankreich, Deutschland, Großbritannien und Spanien transportiert werden. Das Trevira CS textil wird direkt vom lieferanten an die lager geliefert. Bei ihrer ankunft in den lagern werden die komponenten gelagert und zu einem bausatz zusammengesetzt und dann zur baustelle transportiert. Die komponenten gelten nicht als bausatz, bevor sie das ausgangstor des lagers erreichen. 
Technische Daten: 
SC Tracks 25 mm haben eine schallabsorptionsklasse von B zu D und einen schallabsorptionsgrad von 0,55 - 0,85, basierend auf ISO 11654 bzw. ISO 354. Das brandverhalten des systems ist B-s2,d0 und C-s2,d0 gemäß EN 13501-1. Schließlich betragen die abmessungen des systems, wenn es an einer wand installiert ist, 2600 mm x 1300 mm x 25 mm für eine platte mit typischer größe. Für eine maximale plattengröße betragen die abmessungen 6000 mm x 3000 mm x 25 mm, während für eine mindestgröße 1000 mm x 500 mm x 25 mm betragen. 
Deklarierte Einheit: 
Die deklarierte einheit ist 1 m2 konfigurierbares akustikrahmensystem.

technologicalApplicability.value: SC Tracks 25mm controls sound and add to the aesthetic design of interior spaces. The system is intended for interior walls and is particularly well suited for spaces with severe to moderate need for sound absorption, large free wall surfaces, and late changes as the tracks are built on-site. It is installed directly on wall substrate and can be applied in many different markets, architectural needs and acoustic environments.

SC Tracks 25 mm steuern den klang und tragen zur ästhetischen gestaltung von innenräumen bei. Das system ist für Innenwände vorgesehen und eignet sich besonders gut für räume mit starkem bis mittlerem bedarf an schallabsorption, großen freien wandflächen und nachträglichen anderungen, da die gleise vor ort gebaut werden.

useAdviceForDataSet.value:
Scope: 
The declaration covers the average product Soft Cells Tracks 25mm (SC Tracks 25mm) with an aluminium frame and the Trevira CS textile. The SC Tracks 25mm is a configurable textile-covered acoustic frame systems from the company Kvadrat Acoustics. It is available with an aluminium frame in customized sizes ranging from from 1000 mm x 500 mm x 25 mm to 6000 mm x 3000 mm x 25 mm (L x W x H) and textile options under the textile series Trevira CS. The product is declared as a kit since it is available by a single manufacturer as a set of multiple separate components, which are assembled at the building site. All products included in this average EPD are produced in Kvadrat Acoustics production site, in Poland, and distributed to markets in France, Germany, the United Kingdom and Spain. The products components (including the Trevira CS textile) are manufactured by Kvadrat Acoustics suppliers located in Europe (Poland, Italy, Germany, Czech Republic). Production data were collected for the period 2021-2022. 
System boundary: 
The EPD is of the type cradle-to-gate with options, modules A4, A5, C1-C4 and D. The product stage (A1-A3) includes:
A1 - Raw material extraction, processing, processing of secondary material input (e.g. recycling processes) and production of the components. The production of excess components to compensate for material losses during the installation phase, as well as the production of ancillary materials (installation screws), are accounted for in module A1 because the product is declared as a kit.
A2 - Transport of components and packaging from the suppliers to Kvadrat Acoustics production site, as well as internal transport of components from the production site to warehouses.A3 - Assembly of components into a product kit. The production of sales packaging (plastic and core board packaging for the textile) is included in module A3.

The construction process stage (A4-A5) includes:
A4 - Transport of the kit from Kvadrat Acoustics warehouses to the building site. Module A4 includes also the transport of ancillary materials (installation screws) from the supplier to the building site (the product is declared as a kit).
A5 - Installation of SC Tracks 25mm system at the application site including in-situ processing of components (cutting the components to the correct size). Module A5 also includes the transport and processing of waste (material loss, packaging) generated in the application site.

The end-of-life stage includes:
C1 - Deconstruction and dismantling of the system. The manual dismantling impact of the system is considered negligible and module C1 is reported without any impacts.
C2 - Transport of waste from the building site to Material Recovery Facilities (MRF), as well as transport of recyclable and non-recyclable waste from MRF to recycling facilities and landfill, respectively.
C3 - Waste processing for dismantling the system into components and sorting the components/materials to waste for material recovery and landfill.
C4 - Disposal of non-recyclable components/materials (textile, absorber) to landfill.
Module D includes reuse, recovery and/or recycling potentials. Benefits originating from the recycling of material loss and metal components after reaching their end-of-life stage, as well as the incineration of plastic packaging, were considered in module D

Gültigkeitsbereich: 
Die Deklaration bezieht sich auf ein Modell eines konfigurierbaren textilbezogenen Akustikrahmensystems der Firma Kvadrat Acoustics. Das Modell heißt Soft Cells Tracks 25 mm mit Aluminiumrahmen (SC Tracks 25 mm). Das produkt wird als bausatz deklariert, da es von einem einzigen hersteller als set aus mehreren einzelteilen erhältlich ist, die auf der baustelle zusammengesetzt werden. Produktionsdaten wurden für das Jahr 2022 erhoben. 
Systemgrenze: 
Die EPD ist vom typ "cradle-to-gate" mit optionen, module A4, A5, C1-C4 und D.
